s1.desc: a living room drawn on a plain pale background

spans.view: with a long cream sofa and a coral cushion

beats.text: Pax leans over Polly on the sofa and tickles her while she squirms on her back, laughing with her eyes shut

spans.view: with the sofa and a coral cushion behind her

beats.text: Polly lies back against the cushion laughing hard, eyes squeezed shut with tears at the corners, as a fin reaching in from the right tickles her
Polly stops laughing and opens her eyes into a flat, narrowed glare
Polly's face flushes red and she frowns angrily, pushing at the fin that keeps poking her

spans.notes: camera locked (compare 27/69: sofa edges black). Pax is only a fin entering from the right edge, so he is not listed as a character (the caption would otherwise promise Pax on screen); the beat calls it a fin. The explosion burst starts on f70.
cartoon explosion: a yellow light burst then a grey smoke cloud covers the whole picture (f70-77), clearing on f78 to the wide sofa view.

spans.view: with a long cream sofa scorched black where Polly sat, wisps of smoke rising from the burn

beats.text: Pax sits alone on the sofa streaked with grey soot, staring ahead in shock beside a smoking scorched patch
Pax blinks slowly, frozen in place, while the last thin wisps of smoke fade above the burn

spans.notes: camera locked (compare 78/99: sofa black, only the smoke changes). 22 frames. Polly is gone (blown away in the explosion).
